Name: Brunette Caroline
Author: infinnityonhigh
Description:
[size=4]I didn't like how Caroline says Abigail would look better with her natural hair despite having unnatural coloured hair herself. Plus I don't think she seems like the type of person to dye her hair. I made this mod for myself but decided I would post in for anyone else who wanted it.[/size]

[size=4]This is also my first mod so if anything doesn't work please let me know :)[/size]

Manifest.Name: Brunette Caroline
